requirements.text: Students should be able to select their own colours for different modules.
Students should have the option to hide cancelled classes to maintain a clear schedule view.
Students should receive timely notifications via familiar channels, such as email or in-app notifications, when grades are posted for their modules.
Students should be able to submit anonymous feedback using a simple form after the teaching period, focusing on aspects like content quality, delivery, and resources.
Any new features must fit seamlessly into the existing portal, maintaining the current login process and avoiding the need for new accounts.
The existing database schema must not be altered to prevent disruption to the current system.
